profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Devoted Health
profile.summary: I am interested in opportunities to learn and grow in a rapidly evolving field of technology, especially in the areas of object-oriented and functional programming, big data technologies, and mathematical analysis. I am currently a software engineer with a focus in web service and back-end technologies.  I received my Master of Science in Applied Mathematics at the University of Akron with an applicable concentration in Macro- and International Economics and Game Theory.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing Autodesk Revit plugins utilizing the Revit API in C# to automate portions of the design process for architects, engineers, and interior designers. Large emphasis on architectural design practices using implementation of geometric analysis and linear algebra techniques. Mentoring junior developers on software development best practices, object-oriented concepts, and debugging techniques. Additional development of tools for increasing developer productivity in Go.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer working in the supply chain domain with responsibilities ranging from product design, technical design, support, testing, and maintenance of critical e-commerce REST web services and internal applications; Extensive experience in object-oriented based web service architecture and implementation; Technically sound in a wide range of technologies including Java, Go, Springboot (including SpringData), Cassandra (NoSQL), MSSQL, Git, Gitlab and Docker; Active member of development community organizing cross-team projects, development style guide standardization, service documentation and facilitating technical and conceptual discussion around adoption of better practices and technologies; Additional knowledge in Python, JavaScript including ReactJS, Redux, HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Full-stack, contract-to-hire software developer at Kroger Technology specializing in Cassandra, SpringBoot, and Java development; Enhanced my professional background by building knowledge in front-end development technologies including ReactJS, Redux and HTML/CSS; Contributed, as part of a team, to the design, implementation, and testing of crucial front-end and back-end components for Kroger.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Experience working on large-scale, big-data migration and analytics projects leveraging Java, Apache Cassandra (NoSQL), Apache Solr, SpringBoot REST Framework with both Linux and Windows operating systems; Extensive use of Git version control, and Maven framework; Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, AngularJS, and Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Performed development and maintenance operations for a web-based portal utilizing SoapUI and REST technologies, with a heavy focus on core Java development and object-oriented programming practices.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Mathematics Instructor with experience teaching College Algebra; Elementary and Advanced Mathematics Tutor specializing in Linear Algebra, Calculus, Physics and Statistics.

positions.title: Mutual Funds Services Intern
positions.description: IBM Cognos Data Management Analyst utilizing Microsoft Excel VBA programming skills to design and construct custom reports for high-level management and analysts.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Gained strong object-oriented programming skills leveraging C++ and JavaScript languages; Acquired valuable experience using version control technologies (TortoiseSVN), along with Microsoft Visual Studio IDE; Aided in the design and construction of both unit and regression tests for a sophisticated, data analysis tool.

positions.title: Systems Engineering Intern
positions.description: Completed a satellite component case study to determine the feasibility of high-frequency communications between ground and low-earth orbit satellites; Developed strong skills using Mathworks MATLAB framework to perform link budget analysis calculations for theoretical satellite communications systems design; Experience using Satellite Tool Kit (STK).
